gen-gf-phudu-gf-varela: Varela is modern and approachable, its t drawn with crossbar and stem sharing one width. But Phudu brings the bold, distinctive punch, so Varela can be nudged up a size without any fuss.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-varela-round: Clean, modern letters in Varela Round frame their counters with same-width strokes, and the lowercase rounds open out with wide mouths. Phudu is built to shout; Varela Round is built to be read.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-vazirmatn: Punchy and distinctive up top, where Phudu holds one stroke thickness everywhere. Vazirmatn's wide-open s never tightens, and that open generosity is what makes the whole pair feel so approachable.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-wix-madefor-display: Contemporary, and Phudu never mixes heavy and light strokes. Over a long run, Wix Madefor Display reads smoothly, its gently flared curve ends staying apart so lines never clot.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-wix-madefor-text: Big personality up top, with Phudu's stroke thickness never shifting with direction. Wix Madefor Text brings open terminals that go down easily, so extended reading feels smooth and businesslike.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ysabeau: Approachable, with Phudu as a plain stripe of constant ink. Ysabeau sweeps through its curves without ever closing them up, so paragraphs of text keep moving at an unhurried pace.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ysabeau-infant: Ysabeau Infant has terminals that point outward like a pair of tongs, which makes it feel contemporary and approachable. Phudu shouts in uniform strokes while the text murmurs beneath it.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ysabeau-office: Modern in feel, Ysabeau Office opens up every curved letter, leaving the ends of its strokes free. And Phudu, with each stroke holding one thickness like drawn cable, gives it a bold, distinctive partner on the page.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ysabeau-sc: Phudu's line holds a constant pen-like weight, with generous terminal openings on every curve, bold and distinctive. Ysabeau SC, with its gaping c, can drop to a modest size.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-zalando-sans: Phudu looks drawn with a single nib, every curve ending in a generous opening and a bold, distinctive stance. Zalando Sans carries the openness into the text, its curved letters all open-ended, which ties the pair together.
